name: What Do We Reorder?
description: Business Ladder, Operations, Level 2 (Automate a step). The Monday stock order for a café or a hardware shop: 8 to 32 items from up to four suppliers, with sales history (promotion weeks, bank holidays, a closed week), lead times, delivery cycles and a supplier shutdown, open purchase orders, minimum order quantities, case sizes, storage limits, bulk prices, delivery charges, supplier minimum orders, a cash limit and a safety-stock rule stated exactly. The order is replayed week by week by a checker and compared with the cheapest order an exact search can find.
hook: Thirty items, four suppliers, one cash limit: order exactly enough, as cheaply as possible.
author: Gauntlet Real-World Pack
